fix_code:
def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().splitlines()
    
    N = int(data[0])
    S, C = [""] * N, [0] * N
    
    for i in range(N):
        S[i], C[i] = data[i + 1].split()
        C[i] = int(C[i])
    
    S.sort()
    print(S[sum(C) % N])
